name: HAPI Human Authority Layer
purpose: Provide the human-facing API, continuity, consent, identity linkage and authority boundary through which human agency governs ecosystem action.
authority_model: Human authority remains primary within declared constitutional and legal boundaries; AI does not self-authorize consequential value movement.
data_model: Canonical human identity/representation, consent, delegation, authority and continuity records.
evidence_model: Consent, authorization, identity and action evidence remain attributable and time-scoped.
economic_model: Interfaces with I/O, Value and financial capabilities without redefining their canonical semantics.
pulse_model: Human feedback and outcomes may inform canonical Pulse; Pulse never substitutes for consent or authority.
continuity_model: Human/entity canonical records survive product changes and provider replacement.
exit_handoff: Carry identity linkage, authority, consent, obligations and active work into canonical receiving environments.
